recipe.text: Stone Golem Brute: a hulking Slate-material rock golem, distinct from prior husk-style brutes. Started from spawn_rig block R15, recolored every part to stone-grey (darker torso/head), scaled the torso/arms/legs up and head down for a heavy silhouette, and welded neon ember eyes plus moss shoulder plates so it reads at distance. make_npc configured it as a slow high-damage short-detect brute (40 dmg / speed 6 / detect 24 / attackRange 7 / cooldown 2.5). Verified config, NpcAI Script, idle state, and collidable HRP by reading attributes back.
